name: 85003 · Phoenix, AZ
findings: ZIP 85003 (Phoenix) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85003 (Phoenix) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 85003 (Phoenix) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
